Name: MythicPhoenix's There Be Dragons
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
Changes the dinosaurs to dragons.  Choose between five different colors by editing the config file.  This is my very first mod, if you notice any errors please let me know.  Thank you and I hope you enjoy it!

EDIT: Added in "metallic" dragons to match all of the ores and made some minor tweaks to the dragon sprites.

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
